messages:
Maria: Heads up — deploybot flagged a prompt-eval delta on canary for tonight's change window. failed quality gate: +3.2% regression (threshold 2%).

deploybot: [automated] preflight-eval: FAILED. metric=prompt_quality delta=+3.2% > threshold(2%). canary promotion paused.

Ken: Is this the summarizer quant/tokenizer tweak? who owns the prompt set for the sweep?

Maria: Yes, PR #8423 from Joel touched token trimming for long prompts. QA ran a small sample sweep during staging.

Joel: That was me. I saw the delta locally on longer prompts — was aiming to shave latency. I can revert if we want.

Emma: Product is pushing to keep the change tonight. Any chance of a narrower fix or region pin?

Raj: We don't have per-region model splits for this variant — routing pinning is possible but not trivial for a hot change window. Options: rollback, pin canary to old model, or request manual exception.

Sara: Eng-SRE note: deploybot auto-blocks on gate fail unless an exemption is recorded and an eng + qa + product signoff is present. Manual override path exists but requires clear risk call.

Maria: Requesting manual override discussion: attaching quick failure breakdown — ```metric:response_quality delta=+3.2%
breakdown: hallucination_score +0.9, factuality_score -2.3```

Ken: @Priya (product) @Emma (QA) — can product accept this level of regression for tonight?

Priya: Not acceptable. This touches summarization accuracy we promised for the release. Recommend rollback unless the regression surface is misestimated.

Joel: I can build a revert (undo trimming change) and push a hotfix. Work estimate: ~35 minutes to PR -> canary build. If that lands, re-run the preflight.

Emma: QA can run a quick sweep once the revert is in. We can aim for a focused sample (n=200).

Maria: Procedural: if we revert, make sure release notes mention the revert as a fix and call out the regression mitigation. Also include a guarded follow-up to reintroduce with tighter evals.

deploybot: action logged: INF-1124 created to track rollback and re-eval. deploybot suggests: pin=false, rollback=revert-PR if pushed. reaction :white_check_mark:

Raj: Sounds good. Joel, proceed with revert. Maria, I'll watch the canary metrics and signal when safe.

Joel: Revert PR pushed and merged -> new canary build at 5387654330. Running `deploybot preflight re-run` now.

deploybot: preflight started for build 5387654330...

deploybot: preflight result: PASS. metric=prompt_quality delta=+0.1% (within threshold).

Emma: QA quick sweep passed (n=200, binned by long/short prompts). No significant regressions observed.

Priya: Product approves continuing the change window after revert. We'll schedule a follow-up to reintroduce the optimization behind a feature flag.

Maria: I'll update release notes: "fix: reverted tokenizer trimming change to address summarization regression; will rework and re-eval." Also will add a short customer-facing blurb for control plane incidents if needed.

Emma: Added changelog entry and noted the follow-up ticket.

Maria: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. :tada:
